TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body: This month opens up a sustained monthly theme centered on building strategic alliances and horizontal peer relationships. Over the next four weeks, surrounding yourself with allies who share your vision will accelerate long-term goals that were difficult to carry alone. Focus on initiating ongoing group initiatives or recurring mastermind sessions rather than solo sprints.
